summary: Inspected both V1.6 repository snapshots and live main communications scripts: 46 Python files / 7,533 lines total, 20 production Python scripts / 4,219 lines, 2,796 test lines. Identified repeated GitHub Issue comment pagination, full archive inbox projections, and serialized studio/comms Git push/rebase as primary optimization opportunities. Recommended indexed PostgreSQL departmental streams and optional append-only per-department archive branches, never live-queue authority; implementation remains planning-only.
